relics.description.rf_shield.description: An autonomous shield with a shared buffer of up to 5000 HP and 420 independent cells, each with 12 HP.
relics.description.rf_shield.ability.rf_: Protects its configured radius from projectiles, melee hits and explosions. The shared buffer absorbs first; then the struck cell and its neighbours pay the remaining cost. Holes let later attacks through. Allies may be included in coverage. After 2 quiet seconds, repairs one cell HP every 1 s.
0.25 experience per damage absorbed, up to 2 per hit. No experience in Creative mode.

relics.description.rf_shield.ability.dam: Shares up to %1$s%% of HP cost with the two nearest living adjacent cells. Total cost stays unchanged. Does not close holes by itself.
relics.description.rf_shield.ability.shi: Moves up to %1$s surviving cells into holes near an attack over 0.5 seconds. Destinations remain unprotected until arrival. HP is preserved and donor positions become holes. Cooldown: 2 seconds. Does not heal.

relics.description.rf_hive.description: A compact RF-pattern hive that deploys a typed defensive swarm.
relics.description.rf_hive.ability.rf_hi: Deploys 12 to %1$s drones. Fighters surround targets and attack with electric arcs; assigned healers restore the owner. Drones return into the belt and disappear when idle. Tasks are assigned separately for each hive. Limit: 250 of each type per player. Allies are never targeted.
Map the cyan swarm's intercept lattice.
0.25 experience per successful combat action, up to 2 per hit. No experience in Creative mode.
relics.description.mana_hive.description: A compact mana-pattern hive that deploys a typed defensive swarm.
relics.description.mana_hive.ability.man: Deploys 12 to %1$s drones. Fighters surround targets and attack with blue mana bolts; assigned healers restore the owner. Drones return into the belt and disappear when idle. Tasks are assigned separately for each hive. Limit: 250 of each type per player. Allies are never targeted.
Tune the turquoise-and-gold swarm's warding flow.
0.25 experience per successful combat action, up to 2 per hit. No experience in Creative mode.
